scripts.typecheck: pnpm -r typecheck && pnpm agent:typecheck && pnpm scripts:typecheck
scripts.agent:tools:push: pnpm agent:build && pnpm agent:validate && dotenv -e .env.local -- sh -c 'cd agent/cli && elevenlabs tools push --dry-run'
scripts.agent:tools:push:apply: pnpm agent:build --strict && pnpm agent:validate && dotenv -e .env.local -- sh -c 'cd agent/cli && elevenlabs tools push'
scripts.agent:push: pnpm agent:build && pnpm agent:validate && dotenv -e .env.local -- sh -c 'cd agent/cli && elevenlabs agents push --dry-run'
scripts.agent:push:apply: pnpm agent:build --strict --agent && pnpm agent:validate && dotenv -e .env.local -- sh -c 'cd agent/cli && elevenlabs agents push'
scripts.agent:pull: dotenv -e .env.local -- sh -c 'cd agent/cli && elevenlabs agents pull'
scripts.agent:test: dotenv -e .env.local -- sh -c 'cd agent/cli && elevenlabs agents test'
